jobs.title: Healthcare & Life Sciences Principal, EMEA
Design Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

 

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

 

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

 

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

 

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

 

The Role

 

What you’ll do

As our Design Quality & Compliance Engineer, you’ll sit at the heart of Heidi’s mission to make world-class care faster and safer through intelligent, compliant technology. Reporting into the Legal & Regulatory Affairs team, but working day-to-day within Engineering, you’ll be the key link ensuring our agile software development practices remain fully aligned with global medical device and information security standards.

Your core mission is to help ensure that our software design and development activities meet global medical device requirements, leading the practical implementation of IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), ISO 14971 (risk management), and ISO 13485 (quality management systems) within an agile, iterative environment. You’ll help shape how design inputs, verification, validation, and risk controls are captured, reviewed, and evidenced.

This is a hybrid role for someone who can masterfully implement compliance within a modern, agile software culture, enabling engineering teams to build quickly and safely, while ensuring every release stands up to regulatory scrutiny.

 

What you'll do

Drive Medical Device Design Control Processes

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of design control processes across the software lifecycle in alignment with IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and ISO 13485.

  • Partner with engineers and product managers to ensure requirements, risk controls, verification, and validation activities are clearly defined, documented, and traceable.

  • Support the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including requirements specifications, risk management files, verification reports, and change records.

  • Support external ISO 13485 and Notified Body audits, with a focus on Design and Development aspects.

  • Champion compliance in software development by translating complex and opaque IEC/ISO standards into clear, actionable processes that engineering teams can follow.

     

What we will look for

  • SaMD Experience: Prior experience working on Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or other regulated healthtech products, ideally in a start-up or scale-up environment.

  • Standards: Strong working knowledge of standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and ISO 27001, and the ability to apply these in practical, developer-friendly ways.

  • Technical Skills: A solid understanding of technical security domains, including cloud security, access control, network security, and secure software development lifecycles.

  • Proactive & Detail-Oriented: A commitment to quality and the ability to drive tasks to completion in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Excellent communication skills, enabling you to work effectively with internal teams (engineers, product) and manage external partners (auditors, customers).

  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant scientific, engineering, regulatory, legal, or governance discipline is a plus.

 

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who’ve felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you’re doing the defining work of your career.

 

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year,

Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Account Director based in Switzerland.

This role offers the opportunity to lead and grow a portfolio of strategically important enterprise customers within a global creative services environment. You will own the customer relationship from initial scoping through delivery, renewal, and expansion, combining strategic account leadership with commercial growth. The position sits at the intersection of customer strategy, operational execution, and long-term partnership development. You will work closely with senior stakeholders, cross-functional delivery teams, and creative and operational partners to turn business objectives into scalable programs. Success will involve strengthening retention, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring consistently high-quality delivery. The role is well suited to an experienced account leader who thrives in a remote, fast-paced, high-trust environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the end-to-end relationship for a portfolio of 5–10 enterprise customers, strengthening retention, expansion, and executive-level trust.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify upgrade, expansion, and long-term growth opportunities.
  • Lead renewal processes and commercial negotiations in collaboration with leadership.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders and procurement teams.
  • Translate customer objectives and business needs into scalable creative programs and solutions.
  • Partner with Project Managers and Producers to coordinate delivery across multiple workstreams and maintain a high-quality customer experience.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex customer issues, resolving challenges quickly while maintaining confidence and trust.
  • Monitor account health, burn rates, pacing, performance, and profitability across assigned accounts.
  • Develop ROI-focused business cases that clearly demonstrate the value and business impact of proposed solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to improve customer outcomes, efficiency, and delivery.
  • Coach and develop Project Managers and Producers, strengthening delivery standards and customer management capabilities.
  • Collaborate with Creative, Product, and Operations teams to align resourcing, priorities, and execution with customer needs.

    • Requirements:

    • 5–10+ years of experience in account management or client services within creative, marketing, digital, or related environments.
    • 3–5+ years of experience in an account leadership position such as Senior Account Manager, Group Account Manager, Account Director, or equivalent.
    • Proven experience managing and growing enterprise or high-value global customer accounts.
    • Strong commercial acumen, with experience owning or contributing to revenue, retention, and account growth targets.
    • Experience working with enterprise, SaaS, D2C, or B2B clients.
    • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders and navigate complex organizational structures and procurement processes.
    • Experience leading, coaching, and developing cross-functional teams.
    • Strong operational mindset, with the ability to scale delivery while maintaining quality, customer satisfaction, and profitability.
    • Ability to translate broader business objectives into actionable programs, solutions, and measurable outcomes.
    • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
    • Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to managing complex accounts and competing priorities.
    • Ability to work effectively in a fully remote environment across multiple time zones and cultures.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote, remote-first working environment.
      • Opportunity to manage strategically important enterprise accounts and influence long-term customer relationships.
      • Exposure to global clients, senior stakeholders, commercial strategy, creative delivery, AI, and automation.
      • Opportunity to work with a globally distributed team spanning 60+ nationalities and multiple time zones.
      • High-trust, fast-paced environment with direct feedback and continuous opportunities for professional growth.
      • Mentorship and opportunities to take on meaningful responsibility and leadership.
      • Opportunity to shape processes and contribute to the growth of a global creative services organization.
      • Collaborative environment focused on customer outcomes, high-quality work, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: We share the understanding that Abacum's sole purpose is to create value for customers and relentlessly deploy all creativity and energy to that end.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

Good People: We are self-reflective and praise diversity of thought. We don't justify the end with the means and know where to draw the line. We have fun every day.

Tough Love: We truly care for everyone in the team and embrace honest feedback and radical candor as ways to genuinely help each other.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Team Lead (m/f/d) Analytics & Forecasting
jobs.description:
Why The Mobility House?

  • Take responsibility and join us in building an emission-free world of energy and mobility.
  • Look forward to exciting tasks, plenty of scope to shape your work, and endless opportunities to grow beyond your current limits.
  • Join an open, diverse, and international team that brings together a wide range of perspectives.
  • Work or life? Have both! Flexible working hours, half a day off on both 24.12. and 31.12., and mobile work options ensure maximum flexibility. And for a change of scenery: up to 20 days of mobile work from other European countries per year.
  • Family comes first: If your child falls ill, you get up to 15 days of leave per year with full pay.
  • Choose between modern Apple or Dell equipment.
  • We subsidize your "Deutschlandticket" (Germany-wide transit pass) to make your commute easier.
  • We support your health and well-being through Wellpass, our work-life portal, and various other sports and wellness offers.
  • Plan for the future with peace of mind thanks to our company pension scheme.
  • After your probationary period, you can lease your dream car via FINN or your dream bike via JobRad.
  • An office where you’ll feel right at home: modern, well-connected, and dog-friendly-you’re welcome to bring your four-legged friend along.


What you do

We optimise and market a growing portfolio of flexible assets on European power markets - battery storage, aggregated EV fleets and renewable generation. Our multi-market optimisation and execution is purely algorithm-driven and fully automated. What decides whether we make money is the quality of the inputs our algorithms run on: forecasts of prices, market fundamentals and renewable generation - from long-term views down to intraday and real time.

  • You own the complete forecasting stack our short-term algorithmic trading desk relies on: prices (day-ahead, intraday, imbalance and ancillary services such as FCR and aFRR), fundamentals (load, residual load, cross-border flows, outages, fuel and CO₂) and renewable generation (wind and PV) and you keep short-term and long-term views consistent
  • You deliver these forecasts as production-grade, probabilistic inputs (point forecasts, quantiles and scenarios) directly into our optimisation and bidding algorithms, and own their accuracy, timeliness and availability
  • You develop and implement analytical, statistical and fundamental models to assess European power and renewable markets and deliver data-driven insights and signals for our trading decisions
  • You assess market trends and new markets quantitatively, providing the basis for country and product decisions
  • You lead a team of 5-7 analysts & data scientist, develop them technically and coach them in their personal growth
  • You work closely with Trading Desk, Portfolio Management & Pricing, Sales and Product, building the bridge to develop cutting edge products and services
  • You create reports, monitorings and benchmarks to derive actionable insights for trading, senior management and other stakeholders
  • Your models feed into bids and prices largely automatically, and into the decisions of the management board


Who you are

  • Several years of experience in quantitative analysis on European power markets — price, fundamental and renewable generation forecasting as well as fundamental modelling.
  • A solid understanding of day-ahead, intraday and ancillary services, capacity and local flexibility markets, and of how prices form in them
  • Experience in technical leadership — or a clearly visible step towards it — with the ability to motivate and develop a team
  • The ability to translate quantitative findings so that the management board and stakeholders can make decisions based on them
  • business-fluent English and German is a plus 


Are you a good fit for us?

Diversity enriches our team and makes us stronger. Regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, or any disability – everyone is welcome here! We look forward to receiving your application and achieving great things together.

jobs.description:

Hier hast du die Möglichkeit dein erlerntes Wissen im Accounting einzubringen und dich in einem Unternehmensumfeld mit viel Potential und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten weiterzuentwickeln.

Unser Kunde ist eine wachsende Unternehmensgruppe, die spezialisierte Softwareunternehmen für den öffentlichen Sektor unter einem Dach vereint. Der Fokus liegt auf zukunftsrelevanten Bereichen wie Mobilität, Energie und öffentlicher Sicherheit.

Als Accountant betreust du eigenverantwortlich zwei bis drei Softwaregesellschaften und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Finance Team der Unternehmen für verlässliche Abschlüsse und skalierbare Accounting Prozesse.

  • Abschlussverantwortung: Erstellung von Monats, Quartals und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS für mehrere Gesellschaften.

  • Erfahrung in einem Software-, IT- oder Technologieunternehmen

jobs.title: Solution Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Solution Architect, you will drive the development of integrated system designs for our unmanned platforms used in demanding defense and security environments.. You will be responsible for designing, evaluating, and developing end-to-end solutions that balance business requirements, technical excellence, security standards, scalability, and cost. You ensure that solutions are robust, scalable, and mission-ready.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead and coordinate the architecture and design of ISR-focused aerial and other unmanned systems based on customer requirements, operational scenarios, and platform capabilities.

  • Define and drive system-level solutions that align with military standards and interoperability requirements (e.g., NATO, BAAINBw).

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with solution management, product management, software, and development teams to ensure technical coherence and mission effectiveness.

  • Interface directly with internal and external stakeholders (including defense customers, government bodies, and integration partners).

  • Produce and maintain system models, architecture views, and documentation using tools such as SPARX EA.

  • Ensure compliance with relevant frameworks and support certification and qualification processes.

  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the continuous improvement of our systems engineering practices.




What you bring to the team:

  • Strong background in systems design and architecture, ideally with defense and aerospace systems.

  • Proven experience as a Solution Architect or System Architect, ideally in a defense-related domain.

  • Familiarity with architecture frameworks and tools (e.g., SPARX EA) and modeling standards.

  • Experience with NATO Architecture Framework (NAFv4) and German defense architecture methodologies such as ADMBw is highly desirable.

  • A university degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • Business fluency in English and German is required.

  • Willingness and eligibility to obtain security clearance under applicable national laws.


Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations.

At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next.

jobs.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.

The Opportunity


As a Supplier Quality Engineer, you will own supplier quality for a portfolio of critical mechanical, electrical and mechatronic suppliers, from supplier qualification through production and continuous improvement.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

This is a hands-on role: you will not only define processes and requirements, but also audit suppliers, drive corrective actions and make sure improvements are implemented and sustained.


Your Impact

Your Impact

  • Define supplier qualification criteria and establish robust processes for assessing and approving new suppliers.

  • Prepare and maintain supplier audit and assessment frameworks, including questionnaires and checklists.

  • Conduct on-site assessments of critical suppliers and drive audit findings through to closure.

  • Monitor supplier performance, identify recurring quality issues and initiate improvement or development actions where needed.

  • Identify suppliers, manufacturers and service providers requiring Quality Assurance Agreements (QAAs).

  • Develop and maintain QAA templates aligned with ISO 9001 and ISO 80079-34 requirements.

  • Review and negotiate QAA terms with suppliers, covering responsibilities, control points, traceability, non-conformities and other quality requirements.

  • Coordinate internal Quality, Legal and Purchasing approvals for QAAs and monitor ongoing supplier compliance.

  • Define and maintain the supplier NCR process, from detection and reporting through escalation, follow-up and closure.

  • Establish effective NCR templates and tracking tools, and communicate non-conformities clearly with suppliers.

  • Analyse NCR trends and recurring issues to identify systemic quality problems and drive corrective actions.

  • Initiate supplier development, improvement plans or requalification where supplier performance falls below expectations.


Your Profile

  • 5 years  experience in supplier quality management with complex mechatronic product

  • Hands-on experience conducting supplier audits and driving corrective actions through to verified closure.

  • Strong understanding of root-cause analysis, 8D  and structured problem solving.

  • Experience defining and negotiating supplier quality requirements, ideally including Quality Assurance Agreements.

  • Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, while challenging suppliers when quality or delivery requirements are not met.

  • Willingness to travel to suppliers and spend time on-site when required.


Bonus Points
  • Experience with ISO 9001 and/or ISO 80079-34, particularly in an industrial or manufacturing environment.
  • Experience building or improving supplier quality processes in a scaling manufacturing organization.
  • Familiarity with statistical quality tools such as SPC, Cpk/Ppk and Pareto analysis.

    • What We Offer

    • The opportunity to own supplier quality for a portfolio of components directly contributing to the production of autonomous mobile robots.

    • Direct collaboration with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing and Quality teams in Zurich and with suppliers internationally.

    • The opportunity to build and improve supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales its production and product portfolio.

    We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.

jobs.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

Your challenge

As our Senior Finance Operations Leader – Accounting, you will lead the accounting and treasury organisation behind Taxfix’s growing multi-country business.

Your focus will be on creating reliable, scalable and well-controlled finance operations across Group and statutory accounting, month-end and year-end close, consolidation, audit readiness, treasury and core Record-to-Report processes.

You will lead an experienced team, establish clear priorities and ownership, and ensure that our accounting organisation delivers accurate and timely financial information. At the same time, you will continuously improve how the team works through stronger processes, documentation and pragmatic automation.

Tax and Finance Systems Transformation are managed separately. You will collaborate closely with these teams where their work intersects with accounting and treasury, but they are not part of your direct remit.

Your team

You will lead an experienced Finance Operations team responsible for areas such as:

  • Group and statutory accounting

  • Month-end and year-end close

  • Consolidation and financial reporting

  • Record-to-Report processes

  • Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash accounting interfaces

  • Intercompany accounting and reconciliations

  • Treasury and cash management

  • Audit preparation and accounting controls

The team has already established important foundations, including NetSuite as the group-wide ERP and a strong track record of successful external audits.

Your role is to provide clear leadership, prioritisation and execution discipline while helping the team develop and scale sustainably.

Your responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop the Finance Operations team, creating clear priorities, responsibilities and development opportunities.

  • Own the timely and accurate execution of monthly and annual close processes across the Taxfix Group.

  • Oversee statutory and Group accounting under HGB and support IFRS and consolidated reporting requirements.

  • Ensure accounting quality across multiple legal entities in Germany, Spain and the UK.

  • Strengthen financial controls, reconciliations, process documentation and audit readiness.

     

  • Act as the primary operational contact for external auditors, banks and accounting advisors.

  • Establish effective review routines, escalation paths and performance standards across the accounting organisation.

  • Improve the reliability and scalability of Record-to-Report and the accounting components of Procure-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash.

  • Oversee day-to-day treasury operations, including cash visibility, liquidity planning, banking relationships and related financial controls.

  • Ensure clear ownership and reliable processes across treasury, intercompany activities and cash-related reconciliations.

  • Collaborate with the separate Tax team on relevant accounting dependencies, without owning Tax compliance, Tax strategy or the Tax organisation.

  • Partner with the Finance Systems Transformation team on NetSuite improvements, integrations, reporting quality and automation opportunities.

  • Identify and implement pragmatic process and automation improvements that reduce manual work and improve accuracy.

  • Provide accounting and treasury input into selected business initiatives, new products and operational changes.

  • Maintain transparency with the CFO and senior Finance leadership regarding financial risks, bottlenecks, team capacity and operational priorities.

  • Build a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high-quality execution.

Your profile

  • Significant hands-on experience in accounting or controllership, including ownership of month-end and year-end close processes.

  • Strong knowledge of HGB and practical experience with statutory financial statements.

  • Solid understanding of IFRS, consolidation and multi-entity Group reporting.

  • Strong operational finance experience across accounting, close, reporting and treasury, including cash management, liquidity planning and banking processes.

  • Experience leading accounting professionals or a small-to-mid-sized Finance Operations team.

  • The ability to build credibility with experienced specialists while remaining close enough to the details to make sound decisions.

  • Experience working in an international, multi-entity organisation.

  • A strong understanding of accounting processes, internal controls, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience making finance operations more reliable, structured, documented or scalable.

  • Experience with ERP systems; NetSuite experience would be a plus.

  • A pragmatic approach to technology and automation: you understand where tooling can create leverage and where strong process foundations are required first.

  • Confident communication with senior stakeholders, auditors, banks, advisors and cross-functional partners.

  • A structured and calm leadership style, particularly during close, audits and periods of organisational change.

  • Strong ownership, sound judgement and the ability to prioritise in a fast-moving environment.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Why this role

This is an opportunity to lead and strengthen the accounting and treasury backbone of a growing, international fintech.

You will join an experienced team with established systems while still having meaningful scope to improve processes, controls, collaboration and ways of working.

Rather than owning every Finance function, you will have a focused mandate: building reliable and scalable Finance Operations that support Taxfix’s next stage of growth.

Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. jobs.title: Staff Cybersecurity Specialist – Incident Response (DE)

About this role

We are looking for a Staff Cyber Security Specialist (f/m/x) to strengthen our Incident Response and Security Operations capabilities. This is a senior individual contributor role for an experienced incident responder who enjoys solving complex security challenges and helping organizations navigate critical cyber incidents.

In this role, you will lead incident response engagements from investigation through recovery, working directly with customers during some of their most challenging moments. You will act as a trusted technical authority within the team, mentor less experienced responders, and help drive improvements across our security operations.


Unlike traditional consultancy environments, you will operate within a product-driven MDR organization serving more than 1,000 customers across Europe. This gives you the opportunity to work at scale, leverage large security datasets, and contribute improvements that strengthen protections across our entire customer base.


You will work with state-of-the-art security tooling while collaborating with security professionals from intelligence, military, consulting, national CERT, and technology backgrounds.

Alongside operational response work, you'll have opportunities to contribute to internal research initiatives, Bug Bounty Fridays, Capture The Flag events, and other technical projects that help push our capabilities forward.

This position reports directly to the Director of Security Operations.

What you will do

  • Act as a leading technical authority within Security Operations, taking ownership of strategic improvement initiatives and helping shape the future direction of our incident response and security operations capabilities.

  • Lead cyber incident response engagements from intake through recovery.

  • Act as the technical lead during investigations, coordinating response activities and driving outcomes.

  • Conduct forensic investigations to determine attack scope, root cause, and impact.

  • Support customers during active cybersecurity incidents and provide clear technical guidance.

  • Support MDR and Security Operations activities when not engaged in active incident response cases.

  • Work with internal and external stakeholders, including management, legal counsel, law enforcement, and regulators when required.

  • Mentor junior and medior responders and help raise the technical maturity of the team.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of incident response methodologies, playbooks, and operational processes.

What you will need

  • 6+ years of experience in cybersecurity with significant hands-on experience in Incident Response, Digital Forensics, Security Operations, or related disciplines.

  • Proven ability to independently lead and manage cybersecurity incidents end-to-end.

  • In-depth knowledge of Windows, Linux, and macOS operating systems, file systems, security architecture, and attack surfaces.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, networking, and network security principles.

  • Experience with EDR platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, or similar technologies.

  • Knowledge of cloud environments and cloud security concepts across Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.

  • Strong investigative and analytical skills with experience collecting and analysing evidence during security incidents.

  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or coaching other security professionals.

  • Strong ownership, collaboration, and communication skills.

  • Fluency in English (internal working language)

  • C2 Fluency in German (required for client communication)

Nice-to-have

  • Experience developing scripts, tools, or automations to support investigations and response activities.

  • Experience conducting technical security research.

  • Knowledge of threat actors and attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

  • Experience working in a CERT, CSIRT, MDR, or DFIR environment.

What we offer

  • A meaningful mission: protect organizations across Europe from real-world cyber threats

  • Work with top-tier professionals from national CERTs, intelligence agencies, and leading tech backgrounds

  • A remote-friendly culture with quarterly meetups and annual company retreats (in Spain, Portugal, Italy…)

  • Thursday socials to stay connected

  • A generous time-off policy, including wellbeing and volunteering days

About Eye Security

Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 170 FTEs and continue to grow internationally.

 

We combine cutting-edge technology with hands-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Senior FSQA Manager - PHF (all genders)
Senior / Staff Intelligence Analyst, Environmental Crimes
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the role

TRM is building a highly impactful, collaborative Environmental Crimes intelligence function, with one goal: disrupt the illicit actors behind wildlife trafficking and other environmental crimes, and add real friction to their ability to operate.

As our Senior or Staff Intelligence Analyst, Environmental Crimes, you will own TRM's intelligence on this category end-to-end. You will research, analyze, and publish intelligence on environmental crime networks and the crypto and financial flows behind them, combining on-chain tracing, OSINT, and off-chain data from partners into a picture that law enforcement, NGOs, and private-sector partners can act on.

You will also be the clear TRM owner for our partnership with United for Wildlife and Project Pangolin, serving a global network of partner organizations as a trusted advisor, convener, and the expert user who shapes how TRM's products serve this mission. What makes this role unique: you get to build a new intelligence category from the ground up, on the leading blockchain intelligence platform, with executive sponsorship and direct real-world impact.

The impact you will have

  • Build the environmental crimes threat picture. Research, author, and publish intelligence products (threat assessments, typology reports, trend analysis, actor profiles, network maps) on environmental crime and the illicit finance behind it, and maintain a reusable threat picture inside TRM's intelligence infrastructure.

  • Drive investigations to action. Develop and use a wide variety of intelligence sources, tools, and capabilities — on-chain, OSINT, and partner-provided off-chain data — to identify the wallets, entities, and off-ramps behind environmental crime networks. Produce structured, source-cited targeting packages that support law enforcement and partner investigations and surface disruption opportunities.

  • Own the United for Wildlife partner program. Replace fractional coverage with a managed, repeatable program across a network of 200+ partner organizations: case assistance, analysis, guidance, training, and onboarding.

  • Bring the community together. Organize virtual and in-person cross-sector, cross-border sprints and working groups aimed at real-time disruption, and collaborate with partners such as USFWS, HSI, DOJ, Interpol, UNODC, national agencies, and NGOs.

  • Be TRM's public voice on environmental crimes. Brief internal stakeholders, partners, and leadership, and represent TRM with media, at external events, and with other stakeholders to amplify our intelligence.

  • Shape the product. Act as the representative power user of TRM's mission tooling for the environmental crimes community, turning field needs into structured feedback and partnering with product teams to prototype new analysis and collaboration capabilities.

  • Scale your coverage with AI. Build reusable AI workflows for signal processing, target selection, and drafting, with human validation where it matters, so more of your time goes to high-judgment analysis and partner delivery.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in intelligence analysis, financial crime, illicit finance, blockchain intelligence, or transnational threat investigations.

  • Domain knowledge of wildlife trafficking, environmental crime, and/or transnational smuggling — or a closely adjacent illicit-trade domain, with a demonstrated ability to ramp fast.

  • Proven ability to independently run complex, multi-source investigations and produce clear, decision-ready, source-cited written intelligence for both expert and non-expert audiences.

  • Strong proficiency in OSINT methodology and tradecraft, with hands-on experience using commercial databases and investigative tools.

  • Production AI fluency: you already use AI and LLMs to accelerate research and analysis, build reusable workflows, and critically evaluate AI output — neither accept-all nor reject-all.

  • A partner- and community-facing operator: you build trust and energize a multi-organization network, and you are comfortable owning an external partner program, not only heads-down analysis.

  • Strong stakeholder communication, briefing, and facilitation skills.

  • Self-directed: you thrive in ambiguity and generate visible wins quickly in an early-stage initiative.

  • Commitment to becoming fluent in blockchain tracing and TRM's tooling. Prior crypto experience is not required; we will train you.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on blockchain or crypto tracing experience across multiple chains and obfuscation techniques (strongly preferred).

  • Experience working alongside law enforcement or NGOs in a conservation or enforcement context.

  • Experience delivering training or enablement to external partners.

  • Experience organizing events or operational working groups that bring diverse stakeholders together to drive action.

  • Regional language skills relevant to key trafficking corridors (e.g., Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese).

About the team

  • You will join TRM's Primary Intelligence organization and work day-to-day with the Environmental Crimes team, a distributed group producing finished intelligence across threat categories.

  • Environmental crime is a category TRM is investing in at the executive level, including our collaboration with United for Wildlife.

  • Mission-first, high-autonomy, execution-oriented culture with rigorous analytical standards.

  • AI-native: analysts use AI daily and build reusable methods that the whole team adopts.

Team operating rhythms

  • Distributed, not distant: a global team that collaborates across time zones with regular overlap for syncs.

  • Slack-first, async communication; @mention for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1s and team syncs, plus case and partner-delivery rhythms.

  • Regular engagement with external partners and cross-functional teams.

  • Required online and collaboration hours: Overlap with US, EMEA, and APAC time zones for internal syncs and partner engagement.

  • On-call responsibilities: N/A

  • Travel requirements: Up to 20%. Expect about 6 or more major trips per year for key industry and partner events (e.g., Climate Weeks) plus 2 TRM offsites.

  • Onsite requirements: None; remote, distributed role.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position

  • Within 30 days: Take ownership of an active environmental crimes case and deliver a finished, source-cited intelligence product a partner can act on.

  • Within 60 days: Deliver intelligence or training to at least one United for Wildlife partner, and ship a reusable AI workflow another analyst adopts.

  • Within 90 days: Stand up a repeatable partner-delivery play for the United for Wildlife network, publish or brief your first environmental crimes intelligence product, and hand off leads that support disruption.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Meet some of the people you'd be working with. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer H/F
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will take Alta Ares’ autonomous air-defense systems from the lab to the field, deploying, integrating, testing, troubleshooting and improving them alongside military operators and customers.

You will work at the intersection of Engineering, Product and Operations, across our interceptors, AI guidance, mission-management software, sensors and customer C2 systems.

This is not a traditional support role. You will own technical outcomes in real operational environments, often under time pressure and with incomplete information. You should be equally comfortable writing code, debugging systems, analysing telemetry and working directly with operators on a test range.

Deployment & Field Operations

  • Prepare and execute customer deployments, live-fire exercises, demonstrations and acceptance trials.

  • Deploy and validate Alta Ares systems, including interceptors, AI guidance and Cyclops mission-management capabilities.

  • Configure systems, networks and interfaces and execute test scenarios against defined success criteria.

  • Work directly with military operators, test teams, integrators and partners.

  • Troubleshoot issues rapidly in the field while maintaining safety and mission objectives.

  • Document test results, incidents, lessons learned and follow-up actions.

Systems Integration

  • Integrate Alta Ares systems with sensors, radars, C2 systems, networks and third-party platforms.

  • Develop scripts, configuration tools, APIs and integration components required for deployments.

  • Translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Execute integration and acceptance testing across software, hardware, communications and system performance.

  • Work closely with Software, AI, Embedded, GNC, Hardware and Product teams.

Troubleshooting & Product Improvement

  • Diagnose issues across software, hardware, GNC, sensors, networking, communications, and operator workflows.

  • Use logs, telemetry and test data to identify root causes.

  • Implement safe field workarounds and drive permanent fixes with Engineering.

  • Improve system observability, diagnostics, deployment automation, and reliability.

  • Contribute to hardening systems for GNSS-denied, disconnected, and degraded environments.

  • Turn field experience into concrete product improvements and reusable solutions.

Customer & Technical Interface

  • Build trusted relationships with military operators, engineers, integrators, and program stakeholders.

  • Deliver technical briefings, training, and system onboarding in English and French.

  • Communicate system capabilities, limitations, and technical risks clearly.

  • Represent Alta Ares with technical credibility during high-stakes demonstrations and exercises.

  • Create deployment guides, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures.


Candidate Profile

  • 3–7 years in software engineering, systems integration, robotics, embedded systems, DevOps/SRE, solutions engineering or a similar hands-on technical role.

  • Strong Python and Linux skills, with good understanding of networking, APIs, logs and distributed systems.

  • Proven experience deploying and debugging complex hardware/software systems outside a controlled development environment.

  • Ability to understand and troubleshoot systems end-to-end.

  • Experience with UAVs, robotics, autonomous systems, AI/ML, sensors or mission-management systems is highly relevant.

  • Defense, aerospace, C-UAS, ISR or other mission-critical experience is a strong plus.

  • Experience working directly with demanding customers or end users in the field is highly valued.

Skills & Qualities

  • Hands-on and technically curious, comfortable moving between code, hardware, networks, telemetry, and field operations.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with strong operational judgment.

  • High ownership and able to solve ambiguous problems independently.

  • Strong communicator who can translate between operators and engineering teams.

  • Pragmatic, balancing speed, performance, safety and maintainability.

  • Comfortable with frequent travel and flexible hours during deployments and exercises.

  • Fluent English required; professional French strongly preferred.

  • High integrity and discretion when handling sensitive defense technologies.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset and comfortable operating in a fast-growing environment.

It’s a really exciting time in energy. Help us make a real impact on shaping a better, more sustainable future.

 

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

Our mission is to provide cheaper, greener energy to the French market.

 

Octopus Energy France is a fast-growing energy company recognized as an ESS (social economy). **We offer a better experience to our customers through transparency, honesty and simplicity. We want to do better for the planet, through real, long-term investment in renewable energy production and a low-CO2 future that's better for our customers' wallets. We want to revolutionize the energy business through our people, our platform and our use of data.

 

Our focus is on customer satisfaction, and receiving positive reviews is important to us - we have the best score among French energy suppliers on Google Reviews and Trust Pilot.

 

Kraken technologies

 

Kraken Technologies is a company within Octopus Energy Group who are licensing the Kraken platform and operating model to clients across the world. Current clients are both the Octopus Energy retails businesses around the world as well as external clients such as Good Energy, Origin, EDF, E.ON & Queensland Energy - with many more expected to join over the next few years!

 

Our team

 

All technology is written and maintained by a multi-discipline engineering team of around 450 people globally. This includes server-side, client-side and mobile engineers working closely with UX experts, copywriters and designers.

We follow a Kanban-like approach, using Google docs and Asana to specify and manage work; Github, CircleCI and Terraform Enterprise as part of an immutable-infrastructure, continuous delivery pipeline; and Loggly, Sentry and Cloudwatch to measure performance and monitor production.

Some of our coding conventions are open-source.

Octopus is a great place to learn, work with some talented engineers and level-up your skills.

 

Our technology

 

On the server-side, we mainly use Python. Most of our websites are powered by Django and the Django-REST-framework. We also use Pandas, Numpy and Jupyter for analysis and forecasting, plus Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS and Airflow for background processing.

 

We use AWS heavily, employing most of the "Hashistack" (eg Packer, Consul, Terraform) as part of a continuous deployment pipeline. See, for example, Django, ELB health checks and continuous delivery.

 

Client-side, we use React, Redux and SASS; our mobile apps are built using native code or React Native.

jobs.title: Business & AI Transformation | Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
About Singulier

Singulier is a strategy, transaction advisory and AI transformation consulting firm supporting private equity funds, portfolio companies and established businesses on their most critical strategic and operational challenges. We combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution to help our clients make better decisions, accelerate value creation and deliver tangible business impact.

Singulier x OMMAX are joining forces to build a leading European AI management consulting platform, combining deep strategic expertise with technology, data and AI capabilities. Together, we support clients across the full value creation journey, from strategy and due diligence through transformation and execution.

We operate in a partner-led, entrepreneurial environment where consultants are expected to think critically, take ownership early, work directly with senior stakeholders and contribute to building long-term client impact.

The role

As an Engagement Manager - Business & AI Transformation, you will lead complex transformation engagements for clients facing critical strategic, operational and organisational challenges.

You will combine strategic thinking, product expertise and hands-on execution to translate business needs into high-impact transformation initiatives. Working at the intersection of business, product, technology, data and AI, you will help clients transform functions, teams, operating models and ways of working while ensuring that solutions create measurable and sustainable value.

You will lead taskforces composed of strategy consultants and senior digital experts located across France and the UK, with the support of a Principal or Partner.

What you will do ?

Lead transformation engagements

  • Lead business, product, technology, data and AI transformation programmes from initial framing through execution and closing.
  • Structure the problem, define the overall approach and organise the engagement into clear workstreams.
  • Translate business challenges into actionable transformation roadmaps, prioritised initiatives and concrete delivery plans.
  • Combine strategic analysis, product thinking and operational execution to accelerate impact.
  • Support the identification, prototyping, prioritisation and deployment of high-value solutions where relevant.
  • Drive problem-solving and analyses while maintaining a high level of quality and strategic coherence.
  • Ensure that transformation initiatives deliver tangible business outcomes and sustainable improvements in performance.

Lead clients and stakeholders

  • Manage the day-to-day client relationship with senior and C-level stakeholders.
  • Facilitate workshops, decision-making sessions and alignment discussions across business, product and technology teams.
  • Translate between business priorities, operational requirements and technical possibilities.
  • Handle complex queries and challenges with confidence and pragmatism.
  • Navigate complex, political and multi-stakeholder environments successfully.
  • Build trust with clients by combining strategic perspective, delivery discipline and a strong focus on outcomes.

Own project delivery

  • Lead projects from execution to closing, ensuring that timelines, milestones and team responsibilities remain on track.
  • Manage resources, team capacity and end-products while contributing to project profitability.
  • Participate in setting up the appropriate team of strategy consultants and digital experts.
  • Ensure the quality, consistency and executive-readiness of all key deliverables.
  • Anticipate risks, resolve delivery issues and maintain alignment with the client and the Singulier leadership team.
  • Ensure the appropriate capitalisation of project knowledge, methodologies and reusable assets.

Contribute to business development

  • Contribute to building proposals and responding to client opportunities with the support of Partners, Principals, Directors and practice leaders.
  • Help shape the problem statement, transformation approach, workplan, team structure and commercial scope.
  • Identify opportunities to extend client relationships and support the growth of Singulier’s transformation offering.
  • Bring innovative ideas to proposals, client presentations and problem-solving discussions.
  • Contribute to the development of Singulier’s market positioning and thought leadership on business, product, technology, data and AI transformation.

Develop people and build the firm

  • Lead and develop teams of consultants and digital experts across engagements.
  • Coach Consultants, Analysts and junior team members, helping them build both consulting and transformation capabilities.
  • Provide clear direction, feedback and support throughout projects.
  • Contribute to internal initiatives, methodology development, knowledge sharing and recruitment.
  • Help strengthen the culture, capabilities and long-term growth of Singulier.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

  • 4–5+ years of experience in a strategy, digital, product, technology or business transformation consulting firm.

Engineering the sub-millisecond decision engine that powers 200 million daily ad interactions

The Demand Core team builds the infrastructure that determines which of our thousands of active advertising campaigns are relevant to a user the moment they open our ad unit Playtime. At our scale, system latency is a business failure, downtime means advertisers stop spending, users stop earning rewards, and publisher revenue stalls. You will build and operate the services that power these decisions 200 million times every day.

Go microservices load the active ad campaign catalog into memory, evaluating 40+ targeting constraints and 30+ real-time signals, geo, fraud status, budget caps to rank potential user performance in milliseconds. Beyond campaign distribution, the team owns the entire ad interaction chain: processing clicks, views, MMP postbacks from Adjust and AppsFlyer, and in-app events that trigger rewards. These events are broadcasted through a hybrid messaging architecture using SNS/SQS and Kafka, directly powering our advertiser dashboards, publisher reward payouts, and ad campaign scoring pipelines, all backed by DynamoDB.

High-Throughput Event Streaming: You have hands-on experience designing asynchronous microservice communication using event buses like Kafka, SQS/SNS, and Kinesis. You will build pipelines to collect billions of daily API events and aggregate them into our data lake for sub-second querying.

Hinter unserem Associate stehen ein eigenes Preprocessing, juristische Wissensmodelle und ein hochspezialisiertes Agenten-Ökosystem, an dem unser Team für RAG, Backend, AI Ops und Cloud arbeitet. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der diese Technologie noch besser dorthin bringt, wo sie zählt: in die Hände der Anwältinnen und Anwälte.

Du denkst unternehmerisch, übernimmst Ownership und willst mitgestalten? Dann lass uns unbedingt sprechen!

Aufgaben

Als Fullstack Developer mit Fokus auf Frontend und UX verantwortest du alles, was unsere Nutzer sehen, anfassen und lieben sollen. Du designst und implementierst Features Ende-zu-Ende: von der ersten Skizze über den Prototyp bis zum Release. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem CTO, dem Produktteam und direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammen.

Hier ein genauerer Überblick:

  • Design & Mockups: Du entwirfst Oberflächen, Flows und Interaktionen, z. B. in Figma, und machst komplexe KI-Funktionen für Juristen intuitiv bedienbar.

Was du nicht übernehmen musst: KI-Pipeline, Architektur, Datenbanken und Cloud-Infrastruktur verantworten bei uns Kollegen. Du kannst dich voll auf das Nutzererlebnis konzentrieren.

Qualifikation
